name: Channels
description: One row per product x marketplace channel (Amazon/Shopify/TikTok Shop/eBay): listing id, status, price, buybox, content score, and channel issue note.

agentPrompts.label: How is a product doing across channels?
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-product-hub` skill in this folder, then show me the status, buybox, price, and content score across Amazon/Shopify/TikTok Shop/eBay for the product I name, and call out any open channel issues.

agentPrompts.label: Log a channel issue and next step
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-product-hub` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then record the channel issue and next step I describe for the product x platform row I name. Do not change price or publish status here — a price change or a new channel publish needs a review item and human approval first.

agentPrompts.label: Is this product ready to publish on a new channel?
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-product-hub` skill in this folder, then check whether the product I name has the content readiness and compliance data a new channel listing needs, and tell me what's missing before I request a publish review item.
